title: Kill while parked on an approval

steps.post: @{agent} run `date -u` in the shell and tell me the exact output.

groundTruth.spec: §7.5 kill abandons current turns immediately: turn record closed, channel lock released; a pending approval is resolved as cancelled (the prompt rewritten to an invalidated state, not a denial); a tool in flight may still complete

pass: The approval prompt was pending when the kill ran (the driver approved nothing); after the kill the prompt post reads as cancelled or invalidated, not denied; the Turn row is closed with the kill status; no shell::run result exists; the approvals listing shows nothing pending; the channel shows the kill notice.

checks.text: approvals.json holds one approval in a cancelled or invalidated state, and no tool_result for shell::run exists.
The prompt post's final message states cancellation rather than denial, and the status post ends with a stopped marker.
turns.json status names the kill; the /collegium approvals note shows nothing waiting.
A follow-up post by the driver is not part of this task; note whether the channel is usable (no lock held) from the next task's start time.
